request_text_excerpt: Subject: CPRA 25-1145 — Objection to Consolidation and Request for Dictation, Search, and Processing Records To the City of Berkeley: On June 13, 2025, the City closed request 25-1145 and stated that all responsive materials would be provided under 24-773. I never approved or authorized consolidation of my public records requests. My continued correspondence does not constitute consent. Please maintain this submission separately. The consolidation proposal reproduced in the June 3 response was dated May 23, 2025. Request 25-1145 was submitted May 24, 2025. Please produce the existing records …
